}}'''Wuan''' is a soldier of the [[Children of the Light]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wuan, Child}}

==Appearance==
He has a pretty face and a yellow beard.

==History==
He is young and left-handed.

==Activities==
On arrival to the [[Almoth Plain]], [[Geofram Bornhald]] was forced to relinquish some of his men, including Child Wuan, to take orders from the [[Questioner]]s.

Later, Wuan took part in the terrorizing of one of the villages on Almoth Plain, hanging around thirty men, women, and children while disguised as [[Taraboner]]s. Bornhald rightly finds these actions disgusting and shocking.
